settings_language_save_error: We couldn't save your language preference. Please try again.

auth_register_invitation_description: You don't have an account yet — create one to join the project.
auth_register_organization_description: Create a new, independent organization in this vault.

auth_mfa_expired: Your login step expired. Please sign in again.
auth_mfa_invalid_code: That code was not accepted. Try the next code from your authenticator.
auth_login_sso_description: {email} signs in with your organization's SSO provider.
auth_login_mfa_required: MFA verification is required to finish signing in.
auth_login_expired: Your login step expired. Please sign in again.
auth_login_invalid_credentials: Check your email and password, then try again.
credential_copy_legacy_help: Copies the value to your clipboard without showing it on screen.
credential_copy_field_help: Copies only the {field} field to your clipboard without showing it on screen.
credential_copy_legacy_success: Copied to clipboard without revealing the value.
credential_copy_field_success: Copied {field} to clipboard without revealing it.
credential_copy_legacy_failure: Could not copy the credential value. Try again.
form_help_lifecycle_expiry: You set this date manually; it only controls whether the credential shows as expiring or expired. Rotation runs, manual or scheduled, never update it.
form_help_lifecycle_rotation_independenc: The cron schedule only drives the dashboard's Upcoming rotations list and the rotation job. It never changes the Expiry date field's value.
form_help_rotation_schedule: Standard 5-field cron syntax: minute hour day month weekday. Example: 0 0 1 * * runs at midnight on the first day of every month.
form_help_cacheable: Machine agents without live connectivity may cache and reuse this credential locally. Enable only when that offline-access tradeoff is acceptable.
form_help_dependent_systems: External systems that use this credential. Track them so they can be updated when the credential rotates.
form_help_dependency_system_type: Choose the kind of external system that uses this credential.
form_help_dependency_scope: Choose a specific credential field when this system uses only that field; otherwise it applies to the whole credential.
form_help_dependency_link: Add a non-sensitive URL that helps teammates find this system. Do not include passwords, tokens, or signed URLs.
form_help_sso_domain: Enter the domain after the @ in your organization's email addresses. Example: if an address is alex@acme.com, enter acme.com—not the @ or the full email address.
form_help_sso_provider_name: Enter the exact registered provider extension name. Example for local testing: test.mock-sso-extension. This is not a display name like Okta; the extension must be installed and enabled on the server.
form_help_machine_user_role: This role controls what this machine identity can do with project credentials. Choose Viewer for read-only access or Member for read and write access.
form_help_dashboard_project: Choose the project whose monitoring data you want to view.
form_help_text: Enter the value this setting uses. Review it before saving.
form_help_select: Choose the option that controls this setting. Review its effect before saving.
form_help_checkbox: Turn this option on only when you want the behavior described by its label.
form_help_radio: Choose the option that controls how this operation is performed.
form_help_secret: This value is sensitive; enter it only when you intend to store or use a secret.
form_help_date: Choose the date that controls this setting or filter.
form_help_search: Enter a value to narrow the records shown; it does not change stored data.
